summary: Iteration 152: Tested PYME Extended Flow for 'Enviar a Implementación'. All backend APIs (pinpad-models, inventory-serials, send-to-implementation with server_name/pinpad_serials) working correctly. Frontend PYME flow phases (server selection, pinpad question, pinpad selection) verified successfully.

issues: React hydration warning: <tr> cannot be child of <span> - cosmetic issue, doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: PYME detection logic correctly checks both client_segment field and quote_number containing '-PYME'
Server options (Multicomercio MSC, MSC2, Otro) render correctly with proper data-testid attributes
Pinpad model dropdown loads from /api/quotes/{id}/pinpad-models endpoint
ProjectDetail.jsx has conditional rendering for server_name and pinpad_serials sections
seed_data_creation: None - used existing PYME quotes (COT-2026-03-402-PYME, COT-2026-04-009-PYME, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: PYME extended flow is fully implemented and working. The flow is: project_type -> server -> pinpad_question -> (if yes) pinpad_selection -> send. For non-PYME: project_type -> equipment -> multistore question -> send. All visible quotes in the system are PYME quotes. To test non-PYME flow, need to create a non-PYME quote or filter for existing ones.

backend_apis.GET /api/quotes/{id}/pinpad-models: Returns hardware items with type POS/Pinpad and asset_type='Bien' - WORKING
backend_apis.GET /api/quotes/{id}/inventory-serials?m: Searches salidas by client RIF + model + last 15 days - WORKING
backend_apis.POST /api/quotes/{id}/send-to-implementa: Accepts server_name and pinpad_serials in body - WORKING

frontend_phases.pyme-pinpad-question-phase: Shows Yes/No buttons for pinpad requirement - VERIFIED
